saw_lines: Gift buyers take a box once a calendar or party has made the choice for them, and rarely compare.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this calendar beats the one beside it.
Your 9 of 19 copy ads open on the same “le compte à rebours” line. Name 2 or 3 new angles from your own products and run them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Nov 2026
points: 9 of your 19 ads open on the same countdown line, so a buyer who skips it once sees the same story again. Test 3 new openers built on the Paix Dieu Nova beer, the Generous Gin range and your gift boxes.
One exact copy runs in 9 of 19 ads, so buyers scroll past words they have already seen. Keep the body, rewrite the first line, and give each of the four calendars its own image or short video.
None of your 19 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer choosing a gift has nothing solid to trust. Print close to 300 stores on the creative and open two ads with a customer line.
0 of your 19 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put one first order offer or a gift bundle of calendars in the opening line of 3 new ads.

ads_1: Bottle led gift creative that drops the countdown opener in the next batch
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
